label: AWS EventBridge
description: Send events to an Amazon EventBridge event bus using a service account to authenticate.

config_fields.label: Event Bus Name or ARN
config_fields.description: The name or ARN of your AWS EventBridge event bus. Leave empty to use the account's default event bus.

config_fields.label: AWS Region
config_fields.description: The AWS region where your EventBridge event bus is located

config_fields.label: Endpoint
config_fields.description: Custom endpoint URL for AWS EventBridge (optional, for testing or VPC endpoints)

credential_fields.label: Session Token
credential_fields.description: AWS Session Token (optional, for temporary credentials)
